title: AI Apology: A Critical Review of Apology in AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing empirical human-AI interaction studies to evaluate how user gender and the perceived gender of the AI agent (e.g., masculine vs. feminine voice assistants) interact to affect the reception and effectiveness of AI apologies.
Synthesizing existing literature to analyze how a user's age correlates with their tolerance for AI errors and their preference for specific types of apologetic language.
Evaluating the literature for cross-cultural and sociolinguistic differences that impact the interpretation of AI apologies across different demographic groups and languages.
